rdfs:label: Public
rdfs:comment: The ActivityPub special-purpose IRI denoting the public audience — addressing an Activity to it makes the Activity visible to anyone, anywhere on the network.
notes: The single most-referenced IRI on the fediverse. Used as a value of `as:to` or `as:cc` to mark a post as public; absence of it means the post is non-public regardless of other audience settings. Mastodon and most ActivityPub servers also accept the synonyms `as:Public` and `Public` in compact form.
